title: Nadipinchaya – Yojana Reddy Telugu Christian Lyrics
telugu: నడిపించాయా నడిపించాయా యేసు నీ సన్నిధిలోకి నడిపించాయా…
నడిపించాయా నడిపించాయా చాపిన నీ హస్తముతోటి నడిపించాయా…
english: Nadipinchayya chaapina nee hasthamu thoti nadipinchayya
Nee thalupu aduguke veechiyunna kaali hasthamutho
Nee pilupukaine ne veechiyunna nanu nadipinchumayya
Nee sevakaine kaachiyunna naa thalanu antumayya
Neeti baavula koraku dappikaga unnaanayya nee aashaga
translation: Chorus:
Guide me, guide me into Your presence, O Jesus!
Guide me, lead me forward,
Lead me by stretching out Your mighty hand, O Lord!
Verse 1:
Waiting at Your doorstep with surrendered hands,
I come with bowed head into Your holy presence.
Did You come searching for me? Did You call me by choice,
O Jesus, leaving heaven behind?
Out of the crowd, You made me Your own and gave me Your name, O Jesus!
Verse 2:
I am waiting eagerly for Your call, please guide me,
I am watching for Your service, please anoint my head.
Did You come searching for me? Did You call me by choice,
O Jesus, leaving heaven behind?
Out of the crowd, You made me Your own and gave me Your name, O Jesus!
Verse 3:
Thirsting like a deer for streams of living water,
I long for You, Lord.
Did You come searching for me? Did You call me by choice,
O Jesus, leaving heaven behind?
Out of the crowd, You made me Your own and gave me Your name, O Jesus!
intro: Nadipinchaya is the latest Telugu Christian song written & sung by Yojana Reddy, with music composed by Paul Enosh Manti. This song was released on July 17, 2026, through Yojana Reddy YouTube Channel.
